slides.headline: Cake in Pompano Beach, Oct. 26
slides.body: Cake plays Pompano Beach Amphitheater at 6:30 p.m. Tickets cost $64 to $79.

photo.query: Pompano Beach Amphitheater concert night crowd
photo.prompt: a wide night photo of the Pompano Beach Amphitheater with a lit stage, crowd in front, and concert lights cutting across the sky

slides.headline: The Linda Lindas in Fort Lauderdale, Oct. 27
slides.body: The Linda Lindas play Culture Room at 7 p.m. Tickets cost $40.

photo.query: punk concert small venue crowd guitars
photo.prompt: a close, high-energy punk show inside a small venue with guitars, flashing red lights, and a packed crowd

slides.headline: Young Miko at Kaseya Center, Oct. 28
slides.body: Young Miko brings the Late Checkout Tour to Kaseya Center at 7 p.m. Tickets cost $80 to $197.

photo.query: Kaseya Center Miami arena concert night
photo.prompt: Kaseya Center in Miami at night with arena lights on, fans outside the entrance, and a concert crowd arriving

slides.headline: Miami Film Festival GEMS opens Oct. 29
slides.body: Miami Film Festival GEMS opens with The Debut and runs with 50 films, guest conversations and tributes at various venues. Ticket costs vary.

photo.query: Miami film festival red carpet theater night
photo.prompt: a cinematic Miami theater entrance at night with a red carpet, bright lights, and people arriving for a film event

slides.headline: Ghostbusters in Concert, Oct. 30
slides.body: The Adrienne Arsht Center screens Ghostbusters at 8 p.m. while an orchestra performs the soundtrack live. Tickets cost $29 to $104.

photo.query: Adrienne Arsht Center Miami night exterior
photo.prompt: the Adrienne Arsht Center in Miami at night with dramatic lighting and people walking toward the entrance

slides.headline: HalloWyn 2026 in Wynwood, Oct. 31
slides.body: Wynwood Marketplace hosts HalloWyn from 7 p.m. to 3 a.m. Admission is free, with a $45 open bar option from 7 to 10 p.m.

photo.query: Wynwood Halloween block party costumes murals night
photo.prompt: a packed Halloween block party in Wynwood at night with costumes, mural backdrops, DJs, and bright street lighting
